editorial:
Imagine being trapped in a secret underground prison where the power suddenly goes out, leaving you stuck with the worst criminals on earth. You follow two agents who are just trying to get out alive while fighting through a maze of scary hallways. The vibe is like a nightmare where everything that can go wrong does go wrong. You get a mix of gritty fight scenes and weird, spooky elements that keep you guessing about what this place actually is. It feels like a wild ride where the danger just keeps ramping up as you go deeper into the building.

The action is steady, and the twists are surprising, though some of the acting feels a bit stiff at times. You will love it if you enjoy movies where heroes are totally outnumbered. It is a great pick for a movie night with friends when you just want something fast and exciting without having to think too hard about the plot.
endingExplained: You find out that the prison is actually a gateway to a supernatural realm. The agents discover that the evil beings at the bottom are the only ones who can help them escape the human prisoners. In the end, they make a dangerous deal with these monsters to get out. They barely make it to the surface, but it is clear that the horror of the Death House is not truly over for everyone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves prison break stories with a supernatural twist.
